dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: አዎ, እሱ በአጭሩ ይተዋል እንደሆነ.
dialogue.translation: Yes, it will be recorded fully as it is.

key_phrases.phrase: ስለ አልተገኘ እንዴት ነው ያለሁት መልእክት ለመላክ?
key_phrases.translation: Since I couldn’t reach you, how is it to leave a message?

key_phrases.phrase: በመልእክት ውስጥ ልናስተኛል እንደሆነ በአጭሩ ይተዋል.
key_phrases.translation: In the voicemail, if we want to leave it, it’s recorded fully.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: እርስዎ አንድ ፓኬጅ ላይ እንደ ማስታወሻ በአግባሪ አድርጎ እየሆን ነው።
dialogue.translation: You are filling out a form for a package carefully, right?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: አዎ፥ ስለ እርሻ በኩል ከ አዲስ አበባ እንደገና መልሱን አስገባሁ።
dialogue.translation: Yes, regarding the address, I entered the reply from Addis Ababa again.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: በትክክል እንደ እርሻ ተጨማሪ መረጃ አልጋድህም።
dialogue.translation: Indeed, like the address, no additional information is needed.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: እርስዎ እንደ መግቢያው በትክክል እንደ አለሁ ይመስለኛል።
dialogue.translation: You seem to have everything as per the instructions, right?

dialogue.text: በኩል እንዴት እርምጃ እንደሚከተሉ ማድረግ እያልፈልጋለሁ።
dialogue.translation: In the morning, I like to do things as follows.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: ከኋላ ምን ስለ እንዲሁ እንደ አገልግሎት እንደሚከተሉ ነው?
dialogue.translation: After that, what about your work routine, like how it is?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: በ አገልግሎት እንደሚከተሉ ማድረግ እያልፈልጋለሁ።
dialogue.translation: At work, I like to do things as follows.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: እንደ እርምጃ እንደሚከተሉ ነው የእርስዎ ስራ?
dialogue.translation: Is your work like the method you described?

key_phrases.translation: After that, what about your work routine, like how it is?

dialogue.translation: What are the hours today, as usual?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: እንደገና, እንደ 8 ሰዓት እርስዎ አሉ.
dialogue.translation: Again, from 8 o'clock, you have it.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: እንዲሁ, እርሻ እንደ 6 ሰዓት እንደሚከተሉ ነው?
dialogue.translation: Also, is it until 6 o'clock as usual?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: አዎ, እንደሚከተሉ ነው.
dialogue.translation: Yes, it is as usual.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.text: ሰላም, እየ ማድረግ የቅርብ አንድ ምንጭ እርሻ እንደሆ በአሁኑ ይሄ ለ እርሻ እንደ አንድ ተጠቃሚ.
dialogue.translation: Hello, I am here to make a simple transaction. Is it possible now?

dialogue.speaker: Teller
dialogue.text: አዎ, በአጭሩ ይሄ ለ እርሻ ነው አይደለም. እንደ አንድ ተጠቃሚ ይሄ በ እርሻ ማድረግ አለበት.
dialogue.translation: Yes, generally it is possible. As a customer, you can do it here.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.text: አዎ, እየ ማድረግ የቅርብ አንድ ምንጭ እርሻ እንደሆ በአሁኑ ይሄ ለ እርሻ እንደ አንድ ተጠቃሚ.
dialogue.translation: Yes, I want to make a simple transaction now. Is it okay?

dialogue.speaker: Teller
dialogue.text: አዎ, እየ ማድረግ አለበት. እንደ አንድ ተጠቃሚ ይሄ በ እርሻ ማድረግ አለበት.
dialogue.translation: Yes, you can do it. As a customer, you can make the transaction here.

key_phrases.translation: I am making a simple transaction.
